notes.title: WELCOME TO THE BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]A major update for [i][b]Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah[/b][/i] has been released (yes, I announced it as DLC, but in reality it’s a large free update to the main game).[/p][p]For proper functionality, I recommend deleting the game, reinstalling it, and avoiding the use of old saves, since I cannot guarantee their correct synchronization.[/p][p]Now, here’s what awaits you in this big update:[/p][list][*][p]a truly large story branch, [i]The Honey House[/i], full of variety, unexpected twists, and much more – plus more Otkor and more Viorra. The volume of new content is about one-third of the original game (details on how to access it below);[/p][/*][*][p]two new characters: Tikia, Mistress of the Honey House, and Mahavir, an officer of the Kradzhan army;[/p][/*][*][p]one new scene added to that very DLC with Tikia, Mistress of the Honey House;[/p][/*][*][p]two new music tracks;[/p][/*][*][p]one new ending (in two variations);[/p][/*][*][p]14 new achievements;[/p][/*][*][p]19 new illustrations;[/p][/*][*][p]an easier way to reach the “Sudu Ending,” as well as a brand-new prologue that (by design) should provide a small introduction to the game world.[/p][/*][*][p]I worked on editing the English text. Over a thousand different errors have been fixed. I sincerely regret that they were there in the first place. I hope you’ll find the current version much more enjoyable.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How to access the new content![/b]
If you [i]haven’t played[/i] the game before, you can skip this part. The new content is already in the current version of the game—you’ll encounter it simply by playing (though whether you see it or not will depend on your choices :3).[/p][olist][*][p]To see the new prologue, just start the game again (you’ll get a dialogue between two merchants).[/p][/*][*][p]To access the new [i]Honey House[/i] content:
Or you can follow this route (you can use skip mode):[/p][list][*][p]Start a new game,[/p][/*][*][p]Go to the Honey House,[/p][/*][*][p]Do everything to win Viorra’s favor,[/p][/*][*][p]Visit Nesher,[/p][/*][*][p]Return to Viorra, reciprocate her feelings, stay in the Honey House and… yes, the major new storyline begins.[/p][p][i]If you think a downloadable save would be useful for quickly accessing the new content—let me know, and I’ll prepare one.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p]I hope you’ll enjoy this big update. And if you haven’t left a review yet, please do—it really helps the game’s visibility, plus it simply makes me happy.[/p][p][/p][p]You can also [b]follow my [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SINOVAR"]Creator Page[/url] to stay updated. Very soon I’ll be sharing details about a [b]new game set in the world of Savvarah — this time about beastfolk[/b].[/p]

notes.title: About the DLC for "Time of Pariah"
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just a reminder: a story update for Time of Pariah will be released this year.

It’ll be free for those who already own the game and will slightly raise the price (in fact, it’s not a separate DLC but a significant update to the entire game).

The release is likely not before July–August 2025.

Upon release, I’ll also provide save files and brief instructions on how to quickly see the new content for those who’ve already experienced everything else.

What to expect in the DLC:
- A major expansion to the story branches involving the “Honeymoon House” and Sudu. Now, if you stay in the “Honeymoon House,” it won’t end the game.
- You’ll see much more of Viorra, Otkor, and Sudu.
- Two new characters will appear: Tikia, the owner of the Honeymoon House, and Mahavir, an officer in the Kradzhan Army.
- There’ll be one scene (an H-scene) in this DLC.
- The beginning of the game will be slightly altered so that the player/reader has a bit more information about the world right from the start.

Other story branches might be supplemented as well, BUT I’m not promising that. I feel that the other branches are more self-contained and complete.

notes.title: RESULTS OF 2024 AND PLANS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/8576dcf05bf09b47b06c1b6a378e0a764cc0b25f.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Let me share a bit about the year’s results and plans for the next one.

The year was challenging—one might even say unsuccessful—but I’ve managed to make some progress, however small.

You can follow the news on my [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/legendsofsavvarah/]Reddit community[/url]. There, I also occasionally write about the creation process and share more details about the Savvarah universe.

Everything will be divided into two sections: [RESULTS] and [PLANS].

[h1][b]RESULTS:[/b][/h1]

[b]1. The release of Legends of Savvarah: The Time of the Pariah.[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416500/Legends_of_Savvarah_Time_of_Pariah/]LINK
[/url]
This year marked the release of a completed game set in the world of Savvarah.

Overall, I consider it a failure, but having a release is still an achievement.

Why do I see it as a failure?

- Several questionable creative decisions, less-than-ideal variability, and other choices. I don’t think it’s bad, but my expectations were a bit different.
- Financial disappointment. Even considering the significant chunk lost to U.S. taxes (due to the lack of a double taxation agreement), I managed to cover all direct expenses. However, my expectations were higher.

If you enjoyed the game, leaving a review would mean a lot.
If not… well, then don’t bother. :D

[h1][b]PLANS[/b][/h1]

[b]1. Legends of Savvarah: Children of the Sun.[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/Legends_of_Savvarah_Children_of_the_Sun/]LINK.
[/url]
The game will be released on January 23, 2024.

I've written a lot about the project in my reports, but let's break it down point by point:

- We'll find ourselves in Savvarah long before Hasvah from Gods of Savvarah was born. The war with the Horned Ones has just ended, and Akotal has not yet become a semi-divine tyrant.

- This is a technical step forward. We've got full map navigation and relatively free interactions with characters.

- A single playthrough will be significantly longer than The Time of the Pariah. Despite this, the game still retains its strong variability.

- There’s a lot of universe lore. You'll dive deep into cosmology while exploring the personal stories of the characters.

P.S. Sorry, the screenshots aren't translated yet—I'm still in the process of adding translations to the game.

[b]2. Legends of Savvarah: Flowers and Scorpions.[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413920/Legends_of_Savvarah_Flowers_and_Scorpions/]LINK.[/url]
Scheduled for release in May 2025, though it might be delayed to June/July 2025.
It’s already well-developed but still needs assembly. Plus, I’m polishing the text to fix logical inconsistencies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/47c26596dde695fa7de6239156797615b656d278.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/776fb2b63397e9907a3a7cbb05c45e2144e8b2ba.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/62e07567803948f512c3523a06efe2357afab307.jpg[/img]

[b]3. DLC for Legends of Savvarah: The Time of the Pariah.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/e887bf82e415c27885e8772cd59317bd65616633.jpg[/img]
A significant DLC is planned for June 2025.

For those who already own the game, it will be free. Details will follow next year, but here’s a preview:

- Expanded introduction to the story.
- More content around the Honey House and its residents. Expect more Viory and Otkor.
- Two new characters, including the Honey House’s Mistress.
- More Sudu, more Red Shiv.

Two more projects definitely won’t be released next year, but work on them is slowly progressing behind the scenes.

[b]4. Legends of Savvarah: Whisper. of The Ocean.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/99569e580aa6d9fb79596f92751d70f5f72ecdf8.jpg[/img]
It is planned to be a game with turn-based combat (not card-based), where you’ll have the opportunity to assemble a team—yes, much like in traditional RPGs. The setting is the tropical Ankar Archipelago.

The main character featured on the cover/banner is Atahira. Below is her image, along with one of the potential team members.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/3d825aa8b6a5964569d604332b1bf34d3f211728.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/5c877e57ede268aed2aa7ff5496685c06e47dd4e.jpg[/img]

[b]5. Legends of Savvara: Arachnum.[/b]
Arachnum is a province of the Julian Empire, where the dominant race is the Zkitani (insectoids).

The story takes place on Ertheon (the continent of beastfolk), over 800 years after the events of "The Time of the Pariah", when the war between the Dominion and Kradjan had long since ended. The remnants of Kradjan are now only the Aquatic Tigonia, while Ertheon is under the control of the Julian Empire (the Dominion’s successor).

Matius is a judge. He comes from a noble family of beastfolk. His father holds a prominent position in the Imperial Custoria (the local Presidential Administration), his brother is a deputy minister, and his grandfather was a city prefect and a high-ranking military officer.

Matius is appointed as the new Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Arachnum, a province inhabited by insectoids.

It’s too early to say exactly what the game will be like, but conceptually, I’m drawing inspiration from Dave the Diver.

This is a narrative-driven adventure. You’ll play as a judge, resolving disputes and navigating between the Empire and the interests of the local nobility. Along the way, you’ll explore maps, engage in mini-games, and build relationships with other characters (yes, romantic interests are planned, including beastfolk, insectoids, and Takur).

The protagonist (yes, he’s a feline humanoid) will be joined by several characters you’ll encounter along the way:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/051c18ab7dcf65a03f1de349ca037836eb9df3c1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/7283c29d8afb18586776d25a459d3f2a35a8937b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/23a1af96e2009897989a1532f74f0cc029a96e72.jpg[/img]

Thank you for reading all the way to the end.

I hope the next year will be productive. If you’d like to support me, feel free to leave a comment here. I read everything everywhere. :)

Happy upcoming holidays! :)

notes.title: Big Report 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/13effc10a082539b1b808ecc5da058f35e5e0822.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
Today’s update is a big one. We’ll cover what’s happened and what’s in our plans.
Thanks for keeping up with the news!

You can subscribe to my [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/legendsofsavvarah/][b]subreddit[/b][/url], where I post various news, dev logs, and other content. There’s also a detailed description of the world of Savvarah and a few words about my creative journey.

[b]1. This year, “Time of Pariah” was released.
[/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416500/Legends_of_Savvarah_Time_of_Pariah/]Link to the game.[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9a5badba55d02ed9c3fb33649c4bef9ab5263b90.png[/img]
On the positive side, the game covered direct costs, though overall it brought in far less than expected, so I consider it a failure. “Time of Pariah” was an experiment for me, but it was, in many ways, unsuccessful.

- The extensive branching diluted the story and shortened the time it took to complete any single path.
 - Combining 18+ content with a game where that content wasn’t central also wasn’t the best idea.

Still, we’re considering a major free update with new characters and expanded storylines, but we’re undecided. A final decision will be made around February or March next year.

[b]2. “Children of the Sun.”[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/Legends_of_Savvarah_Children_of_the_Sun/]Link to the game page.
[/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/4b510abe5362833d6f9f8b8ecd2e3ddd9bd0b28f.png[/img]
In January 2025, we plan to release a new game set in the world of Savvarah, and we’re on track to meet the timeline.

In my opinion, we’ve fixed many “issues” from “Time of Pariah” in this game: the branching is still extensive, but each story path takes significantly longer to complete. “Children of the Sun” has more of a fantasy tone, with magic, divine entities, and, as with my previous games, is just as dark and harsh toward the main character. I hope you’ll enjoy it. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/ffd49ba96a12d37c13043ab47b5426b14c9db047.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/bf1db124466b31ac1a662cd34b8379100a9e5695.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9392adfc7092bc2ed8acfa66931a93e75f6be795.png[/img]

[b]3. “Flowers and Scorpions.”[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413920/Legends_of_Savvarah_Flowers_and_Scorpions/]Link to the game page.
[/url]A new visual novel in the world of Savvarah is scheduled for release in May 2025. A small delay is possible, though unlikely.

[b]4. Stickers![/b]
If you use Telegram, you can get stickers featuring characters from Savvarah here: [url=https://t.me/addstickers/savvarah]Link[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/f1ac8aa68490a21d3baaac5cb058d9b11abc7f4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/02c4068ffe759867d939ccabbdc2f5bbbbac0c33.png[/img]

[b]5. Future Plans[/b]

[b]5.1. Untitled Project #1 (Arachnum).[/b]
There are plans for two projects that will move away from the visual novel format. Both are in the VERY early stages of development.

Here’s the gist: Arachnum is a province of the Julian Empire, where the native race is the insectoid Zkitane.

The story is set on Ertheon, over 800 years after “Time of Pariah,” after the Dominion and Kradjan war ended long ago. All that remains of Kradjan is Aquatic Tigonia, while Ertheon is under Julian Empire control (the Dominion’s successor).

Matius is a judge from a noble family of beastfolk. His father holds a high position in the Imperial Custaincy (the Imperial Administration), his brother is a deputy minister, and his grandfather was a city prefect and high-ranking military officer.

Matius is appointed as the new Chief Justice of Arachnum, a province inhabited by insectoids.

It’s too early to say what the final game will be like, but in my mind, I’m aiming for something inspired by “Dave the Diver.”

It’s a story-driven adventure. You’ll be a judge, resolving disputes, navigating between the Empire and the local nobility’s interests, exploring the map, playing mini-games, and forming relationships with other characters (yes, romantic interests will include beastfolk, insectoids, and Takur). [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/051c18ab7dcf65a03f1de349ca037836eb9df3c1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/60992bdbd906942a0ce306db1b7c95b33a913acd.jpg[/img]

[b]5.2. Untitled Project #2 (“Beach Episode”).
[/b]This project is an attempt at a simple RPG with turn-based combat (something similar to Darkest Dungeon). The mechanics are still in development.

We already have some experience creating similar games and plan to build on that. The game will feature a main heroine and a party with whom you’ll battle in turn-based combat and interact to build relationships.

We’re calling it the “Beach Episode” because it takes place on tropical islands.

Here’s the main heroine:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/015c7bea76ff4e5ef10162cabb8e4ed4d754115a.jpg[/img]

And a few potential party members:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/6f176a7f3418187dd005fc8f7fcfefd4d81042b1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9060624f9f0fe9fee3c1ecf28796d07d91db7a11.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/90c19c1f163a9583251919b894ef6cea24458e1b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/17a6069601a51aaa35a00af3ec84aa28d55099b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Additional:[/b] A book set in the world of Savvarah has been released, though I currently don’t have the rights to translate or share it, so for now, it’s just a “by the way.”

Thank you for your attention. I hope everything works out.

If you like what I’m doing, feel free to leave feedback or… well, just let me know. I’d appreciate it! :)

notes.title: Bugfixes and news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566308/dc4a9fd8712b5f08ad998b324e848888f4633ee9.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone.

You can read about Savvarah world and some info in my [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/legendsofsavvarah/]subreddit[/url].

[b]1.[/b] Over the past two weeks, various types of adjustments have been made. Primarily, these include:
- Cosmetic fixes (typos correction);
- Fixing different softlocks;
- Adding artwork where it was supposed to be;
- Correcting specific moments where events conflicted with each other (like characters who were supposed to be dead appearing alive, and so on).

Please note that it was possible to achieve all endings/achievements even in the first build.

I will promptly fix any errors that are reported, but aside from that, "Time of Pariah" is fully completed. No further additions are planned.

If you enjoyed the game, it would be great to see your reviews.

[b]2. [/b]The next priority project is "Legends of Savvarah: Children of the Sun." The release is scheduled for January 23, 2025. And there is steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/Legends_of_Savvarah_Children_of_the_Sun/

This is a more standard visual novel in terms of visuals. We will once again journey to Savvarah, but this time, we will travel centuries before the events of "Gods of Savvarah." The lizards have just returned from war, there are still generations of Lyaoka who have witnessed a life of hunger and cold, and Akotal has gained power but still does not understand the limits of his might.

Our main heroine is Nuelli. She has been weak in magical power since birth but possesses a unique gift—the ability to see the threads of magic. Shadows have haunted her since childhood.

There is also significant variability. You can expect 16 endings, 3 romantic interests, as well as mysticism, gods, and magic.

notes.title: Achievement fix + bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello!

[b]1.[/b] Bug fixes have been made, both minor and significant.

If you notice any problems or bugs, please report them in any way that is convenient for you.

[b]2.[/b] Regarding achievements, the issue has been resolved.

    If you haven't downloaded and launched the game yet, you can download and start it now.

    If you downloaded it but haven't launched it yet, it's better to delete and download it again.

    If you downloaded, launched, and unlocked all the achievements, then follow these steps:

    - Download the file from the link provided: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1q4wHjbVGfXsQSjvRK_hncvaHd8VzHEwq/view?usp=sharing
  
    - Then go to the file location (right-click on the game icon in the library, then go to "Manage" and then "Browse local files").

    - Place the downloaded file in the "game" folder (if there are several, put it in all of them).

    - Launch the game. You can go through the entire first dialogue with Varos. Most likely, the achievements will be reset.

In any case, the achievements will be reset in the game itself, which means it will be easier for you to track your progress.

Once again, I apologize for the inconvenience. I hope you enjoy the game.
